{{Quote|SIS Agent Ottau followed the enemy transmissions to a specific location planetside. He'll give you the full details. Your T7 unit can interface with Darth Angral's hyperspace data transceiver and download his communications. Take the droid with you.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and crew were sent on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in order to determine what the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] was planning in his [[Desolator crisis|campaign]] of vengeance for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] at the [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|hands]] of the Knight. Along with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], also known as Teeseven, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attacked an [[Imperial Listening Post|Imperial listening post]] near the island of [[Avilatan]] in order to gain access to the facility's [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|hyperspace data transceiver]]. The two were successful in their mission, though the [[Imperial soldier]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Marcovic]] destroyed the transceiver before they could download everything, but the Knight's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] was captured by Darth Angral's retainers aboard the [[Ord Mantell Orbital Station]]. Carsen managed to convince Angral that her Master was on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and the Knight freed her from the clutches of the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Ferav]] when the Jedi returned to the station with Teeseven. Thanks to the information gathered from Ord Mantell, the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Nasan Godera]] was able to identify a flaw in Angral's planet-killing [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] superweapon, and the Knight and Carsen used his discovery to disable the Desolator before Angral attacked the Jedi homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Tarnis transmitted details of all our top secret projects to his father. We traced that transmission to the planet Ord Mantell. Darth Angral must have a base there. I need you to find it.|Var Suthra|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]&mdash;the former apprentice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]&mdash;[[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] in a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]]. Tarnis had been operating undercover as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] in the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], working as the head of the design team for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], when his presence was threatened by the arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Tarnis had seized control of the Planet Prison and attempted to use it against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but Carsen and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;the former apprentice of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]]&mdash;had pursued Tarnis to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and engaged him in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] before he could activate the weapon.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

[[File:Secluded_Island_Facility.png|thumb|right|180px|The Imperial listening post]]
However, Tarnis's death was witnessed by his father [[Darth Angral]], who had been speaking with his son via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] before the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had confronted Tarnis. Furious, the elder [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] promptly [[Desolator crisis|declared war]] upon the Republic in revenge, and he made use of Tarnis's final gift&mdash;files on all of the Republic's weapons projects and how to combine them into a single planet-killing device called the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]]&mdash;he then dispatched his three [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]], [[Praven]], [[Sadic]], and [[Nefarid]], to take control of the Republic's offworld research facilities. Fearing for the safety of his weapons projects, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] had the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, track the source of Angral's transmission in an effort to locate the Sith Lord. The SIS failed to locate Angral himself, but traced Tarnis's transmission back to a [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|hyperspace data transceiver]] on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where the Empire was maintaining a secret [[Imperial Listening Post|listening post]].<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

Discussing the matter with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], General Suthra requested that Din's former apprentice investigate the base on Ord Mantell, as both Din and Kiwiiks had departed earlier to secure the Republic's offworld facilities with [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the SIS. At Shan's request, the Knight took on Carsen as an official Padawan in the absence of Master Kiwiiks, and Suthra issued the two Jedi and the Knight's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] companion [[T7-O1]] a [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] to take to Ord Mantell.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Hyperspace data transceiver &#61; operational // T7 &#61; scanning transmission logs<br />T7 &#61; found Planet Prison designs &#43; Tarnis communications to Darth Angral<br />T7 &#61; located design files code-named "Desolator" // Darth Angral &#61; creating world-killer weapon using Republic technology|translated=1|T7-O1|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
While the trio took their [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|new ship]] to Ord Mantell, Suthra contacted Agent [[Ottau]], an SIS operative stationed on the planet. On the General's orders, Ottau dispatched a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] from the Republic Military's base of [[Fort Garnik]] on the island of [[Avilatan]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] tracked the transceiver's signal to a [[Unidentified Ord Mantell island|small island]] just of Avilatan's northern shore. However, the island's Imperial defenders destroyed Ottau's probe droid, leaving Ottau without information on the base's interior. Just after Ottau finished giving his report to Suthra, the Knight and crew arrived on the [[Ord Mantell Orbital Station]] and contacted the General. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] general told the Jedi to locate Ottau at Fort Garnik and to take T7-O1&mdash;also known as Teeseven&mdash;along, as the astromech would be able to retrieve the necessary data from the listening post's systems. At her new master's instruction, Carsen remained on the station to protect their ship from scavengers.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

Taking a [[Fortitude-class assault shuttle|shuttle]] down to Fort Garnik, the Knight and Teeseven met with Agent Ottau on the outskirts of the base and received the location of the Imperial facility from the operative. However, as the two crossed Avilatan to reach the island, Carsen was recognized by undercover [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operatives aboard the space station, and they contacted Darth Angral. Arriving at the listening post, the Knight and Teeseven fought through several dozen [[Imperial soldier]]s&mdash;including the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Ord Mantell)|post's commander]]&mdash;in order to reach the entrance of the base itself. The pair then descended an elevator down to the listening post's lower level, where they fought through well over thirty soldiers and Imperial operatives as they headed deeper into the facility. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], Darth Angral arrived at the orbital station with Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hacklin]], the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Ferav]], and several other retainers, and his forces began to interrogate Carsen as to the location of her teacher. However, Carsen was able to trick Angral into believing that the Knight was on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and the Sith Lord sent his forces to find the Knight there. He himself departed with Admiral Hacklin in order to oversee the installation of the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] onto his personal warship, the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], but not before he sent for a ship to take Carsen to the Imperial capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for further interrogation. Angral left behind Ferav with several soldiers and [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]] to guard Carsen until the ship arrived.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

[[File:T7_hacking.png|thumb|left|200px|T7-O1 accesses the transceiver.]]
The Knight and Teeseven finally reached the facility's transceiver to find the last defender, a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Marcovic]], and the soldier attempted to hold off the pair with a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]]. However, Marcovic was overpowered and severely wounded by his opponents, and Teeseven activated the transceiver as Marcovic stumbled away. Hacking into the base's systems, Teeseven located the Planet Prison designs and Tarnis's transmissions to Angral, and he also discovered design files for a world-killer weapon codenamed the "[[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]]." On the Knight's orders, Teeseven downloaded everything he could, but Marcovic realized what Teeseven was doing and attacked the transceiver with his vibrosword, managing to destroy it before the Knight cut him down. Their mission accomplished, the Knight and Teeseven returned to Agent Ottau and informed him of the Imperial facility's vulnerability before taking a shuttle back up to the orbital station. However, the pair found Ferav holding Carsen hostage in the airlock, and their standoff quickly devolved into a fight when the Sith tossed aside his captive to engage the Jedi. In the battle that followed, the Jedi and Teeseven defeated Ferav, his soldiers, and the acolytes, and the duo returned to their ship with Carsen after they removed her shackles.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Looks like Tarnis was combining all your weapon projects to create something code-named "Desolator." We believe Angral's arming his battle cruiser with it.''"<br />"''Then it's no coincidence I've lost contact with Agent Galen. The enemy is raiding our weapon research facilities to build that device.|The Knight and Suthra|<ref name="Architect" />}}
With the data gathered from the Ord Mantell outpost, the Jedi and the SIS were able to determine that Angral was using Tarnis's research to combine all of the Republic's weapons projects into one weapon. The discovery confirmed Suthra's suspicions, as he had lost contact with Agent Galen on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, Suthra first sent the Knight, Carsen, and Teeseven to the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], as he suspected that Angral would try and capture the former Republic scientist [[Nasan Godera]]&mdash;the creator of the various technologies that the superweapon initiative had developed. The Knight and crew were able to [[Mission to Taris (Desolator crisis)|rescue]] Godera from the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] and [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]],<ref name="Architect" /> and Godera later used the files on the Desolator to locate a flaw in the weapon when Angral [[Devastation of Uphrades|attacked]] the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Uphrades]]. From the files, Godera determined that the Desolator needed to charge up for an extended period of time, and the Knight and Carsen used that information to disable the weapon before Angral could use it on the Jedi homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Oppressor''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Ord Mantell was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively-multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears in the Jedi Knight mission "New Intelligence", the first mission of the class' Act I storyline.<ref name="New Intelligence" /> According to [[Hall Hood]], the head writer for the Jedi Knight class, the mission to Ord Mantell was intended as a kind of "special event" for the class that would take the player to a planet that otherwise would be overlooked.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/313793638058569728|Hall Hood|nobackup=1}}</ref>
